name: ATM Transfer Response V 02
definition: The ATMTransferResponse message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to inform the ATM of the approval or decline of the transfer transaction.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMTransferResponse.name: ATM Transfer Response
ATMTransferResponse.definition: Information related to the response of an ATM transfer from an ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
